# Cosmos (cosmos.so)

Cosmos's public signed-out surface — the home page, the explore/search/brand/profile discovery surfaces, sequence, shop, careers, the sign-up start and the public login card — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and explore pages at 390 x 844. The product behind the login card was never reached.

## What this is

A Next.js/Tailwind product with a real dual semantic layer: the sheets declare `--color-*` primitives (a gray-0→1000 ramp, blue/green/amber/orange/red steps, warm grays), unprefixed `--background-color-*`/`--text-color-*`/`--border-color-*`/`--ring-color-*` aliases, and full `--light-*` + `--dark-*` theme sets — 210 theme vars harvested in one pass. The public surface pins `data-theme="light"` even under a forced dark emulation: dark is a declared, un-painted twin.

## The design language

- **One family.** cosmosOracle carries everything: 72/72 and 88px display (700), a 32px mobile hero, 20px section heads, 15-16px UI, 14px tabs. The declared ramp runs `--text-display-xxlarge` 4.5rem at -3% tracking down to `--text-body-numerical` .625rem.
- **A near-black ink on white.** Text, button fills and active borders are lab(3.6%); secondary text steps down through tertiary/quaternary grays. Paper (lab 96.6) fills element tiles; elevation (lab 95.2) is the disabled-button and tab-inactive fill.
- **Pills everywhere.** rounded-full computes to the CSS maximum on every CTA, tab, menu button and search field — 48px header CTAs, 56px auth Next and floating search, 40px category tabs, an 82px hero search. The declared `--radius-*` ramp (.125rem-2rem) covers cards; element tiles use a 3px `--radius-element`; the QR card paints 25%.
- **The signature state move.** The auth Next sits disabled in elevation gray with tertiary text until both fields hold text — then it inverts to ink fill + white text and a pointer cursor. Measured live, never submitted.
- **Hairline borders.** 12%/10% ink `color-mix` borders on search pills, cards and inputs; `--border-color-active` is solid ink.

## Boundaries

- **Captured with the automation flag masked.** The public capture (`tools/capture/public/`) hid `navigator.webdriver` from every page, so the committed readings and screenshots it took were taken past that mask. The scripts no longer hide it (edited, not run); a recapture that meets a bot check records it as a boundary.
- The signed-in product (feed, boards, clusters, settings) was never reached; only the public `/login` card was measured and Next was never pressed.
- Dark mode is declared, not painted: `data-theme="light"` under forced dark emulation. The dark token set is the declared `--dark-*` values.
- Search and profile pages run to ~23-24k px (infinite feeds); `-full` shots truncate at the 8-chunk bound.
- The explore tab-bar toggle state was never shot (selector miss); `cat-tab`'s measured states stand in.
- No standalone icon set was lifted; the mark, glyphs and imagery in shots are the product's artwork.
- **Three entries were read from the wrong element; they need a recapture.** `hero-search` is the header's Log in / Sign up group (204 x 58), not the hero search pill, so `light.component.hero-search-height` says so in its source. `element-tile` is the whole 1376 x 3500 grid, not one tile, and `seq-card` is a 32 x 32 empty icon link, not a sequence card; no token uses those two.
